description: See the coding quota you can actually use, with live token rates and reset times. Provider headlines and the navigation badge use the most restrictive subscription window, so a full five-hour allowance cannot hide an exhausted week. Track Gemini through Antigravity alongside Codex, Claude, Cursor and Muse, plus 7/30/90-day token history. Requires existing provider accounts; Antigravity quota reporting uses the signed-in agy CLI on the primary machine.
